name: INT8 W8A8 rowwise / per-channel
activation_scheme: per-row (per-output-channel) activation scales computed on the fly; weights scaled per output channel. Rowwise scaling rather than per-tensor is what keeps outliers from dominating.
notes: Rowwise (per-output-channel) scaling is the modern default for 8-bit serving and is a separate recipe from per-tensor: the TensorRT-LLM support matrix lists 'FP8(rowwise)' and 'FP8(per tensor)' as distinct columns and they have different hardware coverage - rowwise is Y on Ada, Hopper, Blackwell and Rubin, while block scaling is *not* Y on Ada (quant-trtllm-quantization). For INT8 the analogue is the rowwise path. Recorded separately from int8 because the granularity, not just the bit-width, is what determines whether a kernel exists. No fp16 delta recorded - AMD's Quark documentation describes the capability and available FP8 checkpoints but publishes no controlled perplexity comparison.
